correctness.rationale: Affine standard-simplex reduction and exposing functionals yield exactly 12 vertices. An exhaustive independent 4x4 exact-integer-polynomial determinant checker covers all 495 unordered vertex quadruples, ten classes and six top classes. Analytic coefficientwise and sign-changing-class inequalities prove uniform dominance for all s>0. Convex determinant multilinearity excludes nonvertex optimizers because any two distinct maximizers share at most one vertex. Orthant simplex integration yields exact body volume and differentiating occupancy proves the unique minimum. Checker source and output verified.
